high_level_description: This image captures a mesmerizing underwater scene featuring a school of jellyfish. The jellyfish are translucent with a soft, ethereal glow, primarily in shades of white and light blue. Their bell-shaped bodies are illuminated from within, creating a glowing effect that contrasts beautifully against the dark background. The tentacles of the jellyfish are delicate and wispy, extending outward in various directions, adding to the sense of movement and fluidity.
